description: This file declares the GpxParser class, which provides static methods to parse .gpx files and strings to extract GPS fixes, represented by GpsFix objects.

classes.name: GpxParser
classes.description: A class providing static methods to parse GPX files and strings to extract GPS fix data.

methods.name: parseFile
methods.description: Parses a specified .gpx file at |filePath| and extracts GPS fixes into |*fixes|. Returns true on success, false on failure, and sets |*error| with an error message if applicable.

methods.name: parseString
methods.description: Parses a given string of length |len| to extract GPS fixes, storing them in |*fixes|. Returns true on success, false otherwise, and sets |*error| accordingly.
